Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5293; unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper):--disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.
BiblicalUsage: Paul lists the unruly among those for whom the law is made, and warns that elders' children must not be accused of riot or unruly. The word names the man who will not be ruled, the one who refuses every yoke.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for the unruly carries no doctrine of its own; its place in Paul's lists says enough, that refusing to be ruled is one of the plain marks of a lawless heart.
